description: Getaway Car is THAT girl, the way she turned the Tom Hiddleston/April getaway tea into a literal banger?? 'think about the place where you first met me' ugh goosebumps 🔥✨ The reputation era was her villain arc and this song is the moment she drove off into the sun with zero regrets. I scream the bridge every single time like I was there 💅🏻😭
